responsibility: Implements the core callgraph and symbol-table node behavior for GCC's IPA infrastructure. It owns the mutable runtime operations on cgraph and symtab nodes and edges: function-version bookkeeping, alias and thunk traversal, address-taken and comdat-local queries, call-edge frequency and LTO-streaming helpers, selftest support, and final cleanup of the global symbol table state.
same_name_distinction: Implements the out-of-line callgraph/symbol-table operations declared by gcc/cgraph.h: it owns the mutable global state such as symtab and cgraph node queues, node/edge hook handling, function-version tables, LTO-related callgraph helpers, and finalization/selftest runtime logic rather than the shared type and inline API definitions.
